context.stage: F8 — Tenant Management GUI (Batch 1: TM-01, TM-02, TM-03)

task.description:
Implement the frontend UI for TM-01, TM-02, and TM-03 per the design in src/design/tenant-management.md. You are on branch feature/WF02-f8-batch1-20260606.

## What to implement

### 1. Run codegen for the Type B list page
```
python tools/codegen_list_page.py templates/specs/tenant-list.list-page.yaml
```
This generates web/src/pages/admin/tenants/TenantsPage.tsx (and possibly sub-files). Review output and edit only {/* CUSTOM: ... */} blocks.

### 2. TenantsPage (TM-01)
- Route: /admin/tenants
- PLATFORM_ADMIN only (redirect to login if not)
- Fetches GET /api/v1/tenants (paginated, limit/offset)
- Columns: slug, display_name, idp_realm_id, status (badge: green 'Active' / grey 'Inactive'), created_at (formatted date)
- Row action: 'Edit' button → navigate to /admin/tenants/:slug/edit
- Pagination controls
- Follow existing admin page patterns (see web/src/pages/admin/ for reference — UsersPage, GroupsPage, etc.)
- Add query key to web/src/api/queryKeys.ts: queryKeys.admin.tenants(params)
- Add API function to web/src/api/tenants.ts: listTenants(params) → GET /api/v1/tenants

### 3. TM-02 — 'Add Tenant' button
Add a primary action button on TenantsPage: 'Register New Tenant' that navigates to /admin/onboarding/new (existing ONB-UI-02 flow). No new form needed.

### 4. EditTenantPage (TM-03)
- Route: /admin/tenants/:slug/edit
- PLATFORM_ADMIN only
- Fetches current tenant data (use GET /api/v1/tenants and filter by slug, or add a GET /api/v1/tenants/:slug if the backend exposes it)
- Editable fields: display_name (text input), hostname (text input), redirect_uris (multi-value input — same pattern as ONB-UI-02's redirect_uris field)
- Read-only display: slug, idp_realm_id (shown as labels, not inputs)
- On Save: calls PATCH /api/v1/tenants/:slug with only changed fields
- On success: show success toast and navigate back to /admin/tenants
- On 422 (ImmutableFieldUpdate): show error banner
- On 502 (KeycloakSyncFailed): show warning banner 'Tenant record updated but Keycloak sync failed. Contact support.'
- Add API function to web/src/api/tenants.ts: patchTenant(slug, body) → PATCH /api/v1/tenants/:slug

### 5. Router
Add routes to the router (wherever /admin/* routes are registered):
- /admin/tenants → TenantsPage (PLATFORM_ADMIN guard)
- /admin/tenants/:slug/edit → EditTenantPage (PLATFORM_ADMIN guard)

### 6. Navigation
Add 'Tenants' link to the admin navigation section (AppShell or wherever Admin links are — same location as 'Register Tenant', 'Users', 'Groups'). Visible only to PLATFORM_ADMIN (hidden from DOM, not just disabled).

## Validation
```
cd web
npm run type-check
npm run lint
npm run build
```
All must exit 0.

```
python tools/lint_frontend_conventions.py web/src
```
Must exit 0 with no BLOCKER or MAJOR.

## After validation
Commit to the feature branch:
```
git add -A
git commit -m "feat(WF02-f8-batch1): implement TenantsPage, EditTenantPage, tenants API client (TM-01, TM-02, TM-03)"
git push origin feature/WF02-f8-batch1-20260606
```
acceptance_criteria: TenantsPage renders paginated tenant list at /admin/tenants
TenantsPage hidden from non-PLATFORM_ADMIN (DOM hidden, redirect to login)
Each row has Edit action navigating to /admin/tenants/:slug/edit
Register New Tenant button navigates to /admin/onboarding/new
EditTenantPage at /admin/tenants/:slug/edit with editable display_name, hostname, redirect_uris
PATCH on save with only changed fields
502 shows warning banner, 422 shows error banner
Tenants link in admin navigation (PLATFORM_ADMIN only)
Implementation committed and pushed to feature/WF02-f8-batch1-20260606
